standard_position: Liability is capped at insurance limits; mutual waiver of subrogation (insurance companies can't sue after paying claims).
fallback_positions: Tenant only liable for repairs exceeding normal wear and tear.
red_line: Accepting liability for Landlord's 'loss of profit' or business interruption if the building is damaged.
escalation_logic: Escalate if Landlord insists on tenant liability for Landlord's loss of profit/business interruption or rejects mutual waiver of subrogation.
rationale: Protects against building failure and indirect losses. Essential that insurance companies don't sue the startup for building-wide events.
negotiation_tips: Clauses requiring the startup to indemnify the Landlord even for the Landlord’s own negligence.
